name: Kubilay Ahmet Kucuk
biography: Kubilay Ahmet Kucuk is a DPhil (Ph.D.) candidate at the University of Oxford. His research interests include the problem of secure remote computation, and architectures with TPM, TEEs, ARM TZ, seL4. With a focus on SGX, he received Ph.D. studentship from Intel and completed the AppTRE (Trustworthy Remote Entity) project in Prof. Andrew Martin's group. Before Oxford, he was a research assistant for five years at ETH Zürich, in D-MAVT Simulation Group. He led the software engineering in two CTI/Innosuisse funded projects in Industry 4.0 domain. These projects, the Face-gear Drive and the Next-Generation Virtual Feeder resulted in software products alive in the industry other than the journals.
